top_signals.title: Ukraine Says It Attacked Major Russian Oil Refinery in Yaroslavl
top_signals.summary: Ukraine said it struck the oil refinery in Yaroslavl, one of Russia’s largest fuel-producing plants, in the latest in a flurry of attacks that have sparked a new wave of gasoline shortages across the nation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China Pushes Forward Home-Sale Overhaul as Crisis Drags On
top_signals.summary: China unveiled measures to overhaul the way homes are sold nationwide, pushing developers to offer completed properties instead of using the pre-sales model that exacerbated the housing crisis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UBS Joins Rush to Tap Lower Rates in China’s Onshore Bond Market
top_signals.summary: UBS Group AG’s debut Chinese domestic bond sale this week underscores the market’s growing popularity among international issuers looking for lower borrowing costs.

top_signals.title: Panama Canal Congestion Drives Gas Tankers to Unusual Routes
top_signals.summary: Growing congestion at the Panama Canal is forcing some gas tankers into unusual journeys, from a rare detour around South America to the possible emergence of shuttling through the waterway.

top_signals.summary: The appeals court sent the case back to the Helsinki District Court to be heard on its merits, although the three men, who had previously been detained in Finland, have since left the country.
